newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Farma gains on stable Estonian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Farma gains on stable Estonian bourse.

text.p: Farmaatsiatehas and Hoiupank were in demand on the Tallinn bourse on Wednesday while other stocks were relatively inactive, dealers said.
Overall market volume was 55.8 million kroons versus Tuesday's 38.5 million kroons. The Talse index gained 0.16 percent to close at 252.47.
Farmaatsiatehas was the session's biggest gainer, rising 4.65 percent to close at 114.05 kroons versus 112.30 kroons on turnover of 10.8 million kroons.
The rise followed Tuesday's announcement that it had reached an agreement to reduce the customs on its imports to Russia and to launch a drug store chain in Moscow.
Dealers said Farmaatsiatehas had room for growth.
"They are comfortable in Russia, know the market and the first quarter results showed that further growth can be expected," a dealer said.
Hoiupank was the most active stock in trade of 19.2 million kroons to close 0.60 kroons higher at 131.60 kroons.
Dealers said that its movement was curious as there was no news to push its price up.
The overall outlook for the rest of the month was stability.
"There is no activity seen before the banks announce their next monthly results," a dealer said.
